name: What types of attic insulation are available?

mainEntity.name: What types of attic insulation are available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several types of attic insulation are commonly used. Fiberglass batt insulation comes in pre-cut panels or rolls and is a popular choice for its cost-effectiveness. Blown-in fiberglass or cellulose insulation is excellent for filling irregular spaces and achieving a seamless thermal barrier. Spray foam insulation offers superior air sealing and a high R-value per inch but is typically a more premium option. The best choice for your home in areas like Yorba Linda depends on your attic's structure, existing insulation, and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common types include fiberglass batts, blown-in fiberglass or cellulose, and spray foam. Each offers different benefits in terms of cost and performance.
